**22 instances across 4 GCP projects.** Keyed on `gcp.labels.resource.database_id`, **not** `host.name` — `host.name` here is the GKE collector pod running the GCP integration, not the database.

**Utilisation figures are the peak over the dashboard window**, not the current value: ES|QL has no "latest value per group", so `MAX()` is used. A peak of 95% means it touched 95% at some point in the window.

**Not collected, so not shown:** `network.connections.count` and `replication.replica_lag.sec` are both empty — there are no read replicas configured. Connection counts come from `num_backends` instead.

**Oracle and MSSQL are absent because they collect nothing.** Every document on `oracle.*` and `sql` is a *DPI-1047: Cannot locate a 64-bit Oracle Client library* connection error from the collectors `lrch1e01` and `vslrau1p298`; all 323 `oracle.*` metric fields are empty.
